name: 33-caching-at-depth-openrouter
description: cachingAtDepthForOpenRouterClaude (prompt-converters.js:1020-1063) at depth 1 with a 5m TTL. Two behaviours separate it from the Claude variant and both are on show. A **system** turn is skipped outright before the role comparison (:1033-1036): it neither counts toward depth nor receives a breakpoint, so the system turn at depth 1 is passed over and the user turn behind it is stamped instead. And a **string** content at a breakpoint is replaced by a one-part array carrying the cache_control (:1041-1046) rather than being indexed -- which is why the string user turn can be cached here while the same shape would throw in `cachingAtDepthForClaude`.
